name: Channel breakout confirmed by expanding ATR
description: TREND FOLLOWING. A breakout taken only while volatility is expanding: the close leaves a 20-period Donchian channel and the ATR(14) is rising, the pattern behind every squeeze-then-expansion rule (Bollinger's squeeze, Crabel's opening range work). BORN ON THE DAILY, on futures. Honest note on the implementation: the textbook volatility breakout is `close > previous close + k x ATR`, which needs arithmetic between operands, and the spec language deliberately has none - a spec is data, not an expression to evaluate. The closest form expressible here is the channel breakout with a rising-ATR confirmation, which shares the hypothesis (a move that starts while volatility expands continues) without pretending to be the same formula. Compared with donchian-breakout, the only difference is that confirmation: the pair measures what the volatility filter is worth.
